ShortDescription.Value: Build a ski resort: drawn chairlifts, gondolas and an aerial tram, runs on the game's own snow, lodges and a resort economy. Base game only.

Publish.LongDescription:
**Build a ski resort in Cities: Skylines II.**
Draw chairlifts, gondolas and an aerial tram up your mountain, draw runs down it, and let the game's own snow decide when they open. Guests ski, buy tickets and lessons, and the resort draws tourists to your city. Base game only: no other mod is required.
## Highlights - **Four lifts, one tool.** Fixed-grip triple chairlift, detachable quad chairlift, gondola and aerial tram. Click the base station, click the top, and the tool plans numbered towers over your terrain. Chairs and cabins ride the cable. - **Runs on real snow.** Draw natural, groomed, snowmaking, night and cat track runs. Each is rated green to double black from its hardest pitch, and opens at 3 feet (91 cm) of snow. Snow guns extend the season where it is cold enough. - **Seasons.** Snow melts in spring, runs close and lifts stop. The aerial tram keeps running as summer sightseeing. - **Lodges, Ski School and Ski Patrol.** Five lodges, a school and two patrol buildings, each following a real place. - **One panel.** The Ski Resort button (top left) opens Attraction, Runs, Lifts, Guests, Finances and History views, plus a problem list that flies you to what is wrong. - **A resort economy.** Lift tickets, season passes, lessons, lodge spend and running costs. A ski area's attraction score feeds the game's tourism, so a bigger resort brings more visitors.
## Requirements Cities: Skylines II 1.6 (tested on 1.6.2f1). No other mod and no DLC. Start from a new city.
## Getting started 1. Open the Ski Resort panel. Place a Welcome Sign at a road, then a lodge near where the runs will be. 2. Pick a lift type. Place the base station, then the top station facing it, then draw the line between them. Press Enter to build. 3. Connect a low-voltage power line to the base station. 4. Draw runs downhill from the top station, and wait for snow.
## Good to know - Skiers are counted, not simulated. Chairs and cabins move but carry no riders. - Lifts are power-line networks and need power. Do not connect city high-voltage lines to a lift (untested). - Remove all lifts before uninstalling the mod. What is left behind is untested. - Resorts cost money all year and earn in winter. Build in steps.
## Guides and details Step-by-step guides, every number, settings and troubleshooting are on the docs site: {{DOCS_URL}} Start with the Resort Quickstart at {{DOCS_URL}}/quickstart/ and the Lifts guide at {{DOCS_URL}}/guides/lifts/. Source code and bug reports: {{GITHUB_URL}}
## Works with Nothing else is required. Move It works on every building. If Tourism Overhaul, Realistic Workplaces and Households or a trip-planner mod is installed, the panel shows a notice and changes nothing in them.
## Credits - Modular Golf Course Pack by joergeske: the modular recreation idea this mod grew from. - Meapy's Tourism Overhaul: studied for how tourism and attractions work. Not required. - The fixed-grip lift is a tribute to the Pallavicini lift at Arapahoe Basin. - Built with Claude (Anthropic) for decompilation, prefab work and asset generation; direction and testing by the author. - Full credits and licenses: {{DOCS_URL}}/credits/

Publish.ChangeLog: First public release. - Four lift types: fixed-grip triple chairlift, detachable quad chairlift, gondola and aerial tram. Chairs and cabins move along the cable; the tram shuttles two cabins. - One lift tool: click the base station and the top station, click the line to add a tower, drag to move one, Enter builds. The tower planner fits tower heights to the terrain with the fewest towers the type allows. Towers are numbered. - Ski runs you draw: natural, groomed, snowmaking, night and cat track, each rated green to double black from its slope. - Cat track grading tool. - Snow-depth run system: runs open at 3 ft (91 cm) on 60 percent of the run, snow guns on snowmaking and night runs (October to March), powder days, seasons. - Welcome Sign, five lodges, Ski School, two patrol buildings. - The Ski Resort panel: Attraction, Runs, Lifts, Guests, Finances and History views, a problem list and a build strip. - Economy: lift tickets, season passes, lessons, lodge spend, off-season half staff. - Works on the base game; no other mod is required.
